title: How to test a package the way a consumer installs it
problem: My library passes every test in the workspace, where path aliases, loader hooks and a hoisted node_modules resolve whatever the source asks for, and then a consumer runs npm install and the published entry fails to load or throws on the first call.
outcome: A suite that installs the packed tarball into a directory outside the workspace, loads every exports entry under plain Node with import and with require, calls the package from a child process the way a consumer does, and can repeat all of that on the oldest Node release the package declares.

knowledge: A library whose build writes a publishable directory with its own package.json and an exports map
A suite on @hyperfrontend/testing, or on node:test, running on Node.js 22.18 or later
npm available on the machine that runs the suite, since the install goes through it
